title: Cross-layer answer-position micro-write trajectory
question: Is a teacher-forced trajectory of answer-position attention writes bidirectionally and identity-specifically sufficient, and can a proper prefix hand control back to the natural network?

dependency.new_object: within-block answer-position attention and MLP writes across time

models.selection_rule: first three behavior-qualified seeds per depth

programs.attention_prefixes: replace donor attention writes at answer position 22 from layer 0 through each registered end layer
programs.attention_full_wrong_identity: same trajectory using hwrong11 donor; must recover the wrong donor answer and avoid the h11 target
programs.attention_pre_source_null: replace attention writes at position 2, whose causal history is identical

secondary_gates.proper_prefix_definition: shortest confirmed attention prefix ends before the final layer

hard_stops: Development seeds and probe outputs are excluded from the formal seed pools and evidence denominator.
Behavior qualification cannot inspect micro-writes or intervention outcomes.
Oracle population scores cannot select the shortest attention prefix.
Confirmation cannot select a prefix, component family, threshold, or seed.
A full trajectory is teacher-forced external control and cannot by itself establish a self-generated natural program.
Attention sufficiency, proper-prefix self-maintenance, and attention-over-MLP advantage are separate claims.
No head search, learned donor, pretrained model, or post-reveal expansion is allowed.
One formal run and zero adaptive rounds.
